hr.overtime.v1.ApproveOvertimeBody.description: ApproveOvertimeBody carries approval decision fields bound from the HTTP payload.

approved.description: True to approve, false to reject.

multiplier_applied.description: Pay multiplier to apply (e.g. 1.5); absent to use the default rate.

rejection_reason.description: Reason for rejection; absent if approving.

overtime_request_id.description: ID of the overtime request being reviewed.

success.description: Whether the approval action was processed.

date.description: Date the overtime is planned for (ISO-8601 date).

planned_extra_minutes.description: Number of extra minutes planned beyond the regular shift.

employee_id.description: Filter by employee; absent to include all employees.

status.description: Filter by status; absent to include all statuses.

limit.description: Page size used for this request.

requests.description: Page of overtime requests matching the filters.

total.description: Total number of matching overtime requests across all pages.

hr.overtime.v1.OvertimeRequestPayload.description: OvertimeRequestPayload is a single employee's request to work overtime.

approved_by.description: Employee ID of the approver; absent if not yet approved.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when this record was created.

current_approval_level.description: Current step in a multi-level approval chain.

date.description: Date the overtime is planned for (ISO-8601 date).

id.description: Unique identifier for the overtime request.

multiplier_applied.description: Pay multiplier applied to the overtime hours (e.g. 1.5); absent if not yet calculated.

owner_id.description: Tenant owner this request belongs to.

planned_extra_minutes.description: Number of extra minutes planned beyond the regular shift.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp when this record was last updated.

get.description: ListOvertimeRequests returns overtime requests with optional filters.

schema.description: Filter by employee; absent to include all employees.
Filter by status; absent to include all statuses.
